ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture is a cycle diagram, containing a tree on the left, a deer below, a factory at the upper right, and shrubs/plants on the right. Multiple curved arrows are marked with letters. The letter G is marked beside an arrow on the right that curves downward and points to the shrubs/green plant area. Reasoning: The question asks which letter represents the stage where photosynthesis occurs. Photosynthesis occurs in plants, and plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air and carry out photosynthesis. The stage pointing to the plant/shrub area in the picture is marked as G, so the answer is G.
